_comment: Regexes are matched against the body of probe responses (404, 400, 500 and malformed-request pages). Labels containing 'takeover risk' indicate a likely dangling DNS/hosting record; 'misconfig' or 'serious' labels should be raised in severity.

fingerprints.label: Django (debug mode enabled — serious misconfig if seen in production)
PHP (errors displayed — misconfig if in production)
PHP (warnings displayed — misconfig if in production)

fingerprints.pattern: Whoops, looks like something went wrong|Illuminate\\\\|Illuminate/
fingerprints.label: Laravel (debug stack trace)

fingerprints.pattern: Werkzeug Debugger|The debugger caught an exception|console\.\s*Console locked
fingerprints.label: Flask / Werkzeug debugger (RCE risk — serious misconfig)

fingerprints.pattern: Using the URLconf defined in|Page not found \(404\)|Request Method:\s*GET\s*Request URL:
fingerprints.label: Django (404 debug page — DEBUG=True)

fingerprints.pattern: We're sorry, but something went wrong|Action Controller: Exception caught|ActiveRecord::
fingerprints.label: Ruby on Rails

fingerprints.pattern: Runtime Error|Version Information: Microsoft \.NET Framework|\s*Stack Trace:\s*
fingerprints.label: ASP.NET (YSOD stack trace)

fingerprints.pattern: An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request
fingerprints.label: ASP.NET Core (Developer Exception Page)
Microsoft OLE DB/ODBC error (DB info disclosure)

fingerprints.pattern: You have an error in your SQL syntax|mysql_fetch|mysqli_sql_exception|MySQLSyntaxErrorException|Warning: mysql_
fingerprints.label: MySQL (SQL error disclosed)

fingerprints.pattern: Unclosed quotation mark|SqlException|Incorrect syntax near|Msg \d+, Level \d+, State \d+
fingerprints.label: Microsoft SQL Server (SQL error disclosed)

fingerprints.pattern: File \".*\", line \d+, in |Traceback \(most recent call last\)
fingerprints.label: Python (stack trace)

fingerprints.pattern: Application error: a server-side exception has occurred|This page could not be found\.
fingerprints.label: Next.js (error page)

fingerprints.pattern: LiteSpeed Web Server|Proudly Served by LiteSpeed|litespeedtech
fingerprints.label: LiteSpeed (error page)

fingerprints.pattern: ERROR: The requested URL could not be retrieved|Generated .* by squid
fingerprints.label: Squid (error page)

fingerprints.pattern: 503 Service Unavailable.*No server is available to handle this request
fingerprints.label: HAProxy (503 error page)

fingerprints.pattern: ERROR: The request could not be satisfied|Generated by cloudfront \(CloudFront\)
fingerprints.label: Amazon CloudFront (error page)
Amazon S3 (error XML; NoSuchBucket may indicate takeover risk)

fingerprints.pattern: The resource you are looking for has been removed|Error 404 - Web app not found|404 Web Site not found
fingerprints.label: Azure App Service (error / possible takeover)

fingerprints.pattern: There isn't a GitHub Pages site here|For root URLs \(like http://example\.com/\) you must provide an index\.html
fingerprints.label: GitHub Pages (unclaimed — takeover risk)

fingerprints.pattern: Sorry, this shop is currently unavailable|Only one step left!
fingerprints.label: Shopify (unclaimed shop — takeover risk)

fingerprints.pattern: Not Found - Request ID:|Page Not Found.*Netlify
fingerprints.label: Netlify (404)

fingerprints.pattern: DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND|The deployment could not be found on Vercel|NOT_FOUND\s*Code:
fingerprints.label: Vercel (deployment not found — takeover risk)

fingerprints.pattern: Error establishing a database connection|There has been a critical error on this website
fingerprints.label: WordPress (critical error / DB failure)

fingerprints.pattern: The website encountered an unexpected error|Drupal\\\\Core\\\\|Drupal\\\\
fingerprints.label: Drupal (unexpected error / stack trace)

fingerprints.pattern: There has been an error processing your request|Magento\\\\Framework|Magento\\\\
fingerprints.label: Magento (error)

fingerprints.pattern: Parse error:.*in.*\.php on line|syntax error, unexpected
fingerprints.label: PHP (parse error disclosed)
PHP (notices displayed — misconfig if in production)

fingerprints.pattern: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers|no healthy upstream
fingerprints.label: Envoy / Istio (upstream error)

fingerprints.pattern: Bad Request - Invalid Hostname|HTTP Error 400\. The request hostname is invalid
fingerprints.label: IIS (invalid hostname)

fingerprints.pattern: Whitelabel Error Page.*This application has no explicit mapping for /error
fingerprints.label: Spring Boot (whitelabel, no /error mapping)
Apache module versions disclosed in banner
